records.subject: landscaping contract parties and signature
records.value: Harbor View and Bramblewick Grounds LLC, signed January 25, 2024
records.quote: Between Harbor View Condominium Association (the Client) and Bramblewick Grounds LLC (the Contractor). Signed January 25, 2024.

records.subject: landscaping contract term
records.quote: This agreement runs from April 1, 2024 to March 31, 2026.

records.subject: landscaping fee
records.quote: The Client pays the Contractor $1,450 per month.

records.subject: landscaping renewal and notice period
records.value: Auto-renews for one year unless written notice at least 60 days before term ends
records.quote: renews automatically for successive one-year terms unless either party gives written notice of non-renewal at least sixty (60) days before the end of the current term.

records.subject: landscaping price increase on renewal
records.quote: On each renewal the monthly fee may increase by no more than four percent (4%).

records.subject: landscaping scope
records.value: Lawn care, hedges, seasonal planting, leaf removal
records.quote: Lawn care, hedges, seasonal planting and leaf removal for all common grounds.
